Polyacetyleneanditshomologueshavebeen studiedas organicsemiconductors [1-3],membranesforgasseparationandforliquid-mixture separation[4],chiro-optical materials[5,6],side-chainliquidcrystals[7-9],materials for chemical sensors [10],and materialsfor nonlinear opticalproperty [11,12]andphotoluminescenceandelectroluminescenceproperties [13-17].

Polyacetyleneswithionicnaturehavepotentialasmaterialsformixedionicandelectronicconductivities,energy storage devices suchasbatteries andpermselective membrane,andlight-emittingdevices duetothetheirextensive conjugationandvariousfunctionalities [2,18].The synthesis of simple mono- and disubstituted ionic polyacetylenes fromethynylpyridineshadbeencarriedoutwiththeactivationoftheacetylenebondinethynylpyridines [18,19].We have also studiedonthe synthesis and characterizationof the poly(2-ethynylpyridine)-based conjugatedpolymers havingvariousfunctionalities [2,9,14].
Inthis paper, we report the synthesis ofnovelionic conjugated polymers having different counter-anion (iodide,tetraphenylborate)andthecharacterizationofresulting ionic conjugated polymers.

Theconjugatedionicpolymer,poly(2-ethynyl-N-methylpyridiniumiodide)(PEMPI) waspreparedbythedirect polymerization of 2-ethynylpyridine with methyliodide without any initiator system in methanol solvent. The polymerization was performed at 70 C after standing for1hbecauseofthelowboilingtemperatureofmethyl iodide. Another ionic polymer, poly(2-ethynyl-N-methylpyridiniumtetraphenylborate)(PEMPTPB)waseasilypreparedbytheion-exchangereactionofPEMPIwithsodium tetraphenylborate inmethanolsolvent.FT-IRspectrawere obtainedwithaBrukerEQUINOX55spectrometerusing aKBrpellet.NMRspectrawererecordedonaVarian500MHzFT-NMR spectrometer(Model:Unity INOVA)in DMSO-d6.
